dct_description_sm: The purpose of this project is to determine background levels of mercury and hydrocarbons in sediment and biota (benthic invertebrates, zooplankton, and fish) in the Beaufort Sea as part of the Beaufort Regional Environmental Assessment. For mercury, the objectives of this research include: (a) establishing the background levels and composition of mercury in both abiotic and biotic compartments of the Beaufort Sea outer shelf and slope regions prior to further oil and gas development, (b) further research on the environmental pathways of mercury, including its delivery, transport, and elimination from Arctic marine ecosystems, and (c) understand the potential effects of development and differentiate those from other stressors, such as climate change. For hydrocarbons, the research objectives include: (a) establishing background levels and composition of sentinel hydrocarbon compounds in abiotic and biotic compartments of the Beaufort Sea outer shelf and slope regions prior to further oil and gas development, (b) determine the nature and levels of hydrocarbons affecting key fishes, and (c) measure indicators of fish health and link these to hydrocarbon exposure and internal metabolite concentrations. This information will be useful in assessing any changes to the environment due to oil spills, marine spills, and related accidents.
dct_title_s: BREA Marine Fishes Project - Mercury and Hydrocarbons Data Collected from the Canadian Beaufort Sea
